yardi_breeze.name: Yardi Breeze
yardi_breeze.target_segment: Small to mid-size portfolios (up to 1,000 units), owner-operators, self-managed properties
key_value_props: Intuitive cloud-based interface with minimal training required
Built-in online payments and tenant portal
Automated accounting and financial reporting
Maintenance request tracking with mobile access
Affordable per-unit pricing with no long-term contracts
RentCafe marketing website included

common_objections.too_simple: Breeze handles up to 1,000 units with full accounting, maintenance, and marketing. It covers 95% of what most operators need without the complexity overhead.
common_objections.limited_reporting: Breeze includes 30+ standard reports covering financials, occupancy, and maintenance. For custom reporting needs, Breeze Premier adds advanced analytics.
common_objections.not_scalable: Breeze is designed as an on-ramp. When you grow past its capabilities, upgrading to Breeze Premier or Voyager is seamless with full data migration.
common_objections.already_have_system: Most operators switching from spreadsheets or basic tools see 15-20 hours per month in time savings within the first 90 days.

upgrade_path.from_dos_era: Direct migration from DOS-based systems. Yardi handles full data conversion including historical financials. Typical migration: 4-6 weeks.
upgrade_path.from_spreadsheets: Import tenant, unit, and financial data via structured templates. Onboarding team provides white-glove setup assistance.
upgrade_path.from_genesis: Yardi-to-Yardi migration is streamlined. All historical data transfers automatically. Most Genesis users are up and running in 2-3 weeks.

breeze_premier.name: Yardi Breeze Premier
breeze_premier.target_segment: Growing portfolios (500-5,000 units), regional operators, mixed-use portfolios, companies outgrowing entry-level systems
key_value_props: Everything in Breeze plus advanced features
Job cost tracking for renovation and construction projects
Advanced budgeting and forecasting tools
Custom report builder with drag-and-drop interface
Corporate-level accounting with multi-entity support
Investor reporting and document management
Integration with Yardi Marketplace vendor network

common_objections.price_jump_from_breeze: Premier typically costs 30-40% more than Breeze but eliminates the need for 2-3 separate tools most operators bolt on. Net savings average $200-400/month.
common_objections.too_complex: Premier uses the same intuitive Breeze interface. Advanced features are modular - enable only what you need. No feature bloat.
common_objections.competitor_comparison: Unlike AppFolio or Buildium, Premier includes investment management, job costing, and a full vendor marketplace at no additional per-feature cost.
common_objections.migration_risk: Yardi's migration team has completed 10,000+ transitions. We guarantee data integrity and provide parallel running periods.

upgrade_path.from_appfolio: Full data migration including tenant history, lease terms, and financials. AppFolio's limited API means CSV export/import, but Yardi's team handles the entire process. 6-8 week timeline.
upgrade_path.from_buildium: Direct migration path with Yardi handling all data conversion. Most Buildium users gain immediate access to superior reporting and accounting depth.
upgrade_path.from_realpage: Structured migration from RealPage OneSite. Yardi provides dedicated project manager and parallel system running for 30 days.
upgrade_path.from_professional: Seamless Yardi-to-Yardi upgrade. All configurations, workflows, and historical data carry forward. Typical timeline: 3-4 weeks.
upgrade_path.from_genesis: Natural upgrade path. Genesis users retain familiarity while gaining cloud access, mobile capabilities, and modern reporting.

voyager_8.name: Voyager 8
voyager_8.target_segment: Enterprise portfolios (2,000+ units), institutional owners, REITs, national management companies, mixed commercial/residential portfolios
key_value_props: Enterprise-grade platform with unlimited scalability
Full commercial and residential property management
Advanced investment management and asset tracking
Comprehensive compliance and regulatory reporting
Yardi Matrix market intelligence integration
Procure to Pay with automated invoice processing
Business intelligence dashboards with real-time KPIs
Multi-site, multi-entity, multi-currency support
Full API suite for third-party integrations
RentCafe suite for marketing, leasing, and resident services

common_objections.implementation_time: Voyager 8 implementations follow a structured methodology. Typical enterprise deployment: 12-16 weeks with phased rollout. Yardi provides dedicated implementation team.
common_objections.cost: Voyager's total cost of ownership is typically 20-30% lower than cobbling together multiple point solutions. ROI analysis available for your specific portfolio.
common_objections.learning_curve: Yardi provides role-based training programs, online Yardi University courses, and ongoing support. Most users are productive within 2 weeks of go-live.
common_objections.already_on_competitor: Voyager 8 is the only platform that truly unifies residential, commercial, and investment management. Competitors require multiple products to match this capability.
common_objections.happy_with_current: We understand. But consider: are you getting real-time portfolio analytics, automated compliance reporting, and integrated market data? Voyager 8 provides strategic advantage, not just property management.

upgrade_path.from_mri: MRI to Voyager migration is well-documented with hundreds of successful transitions. Full data mapping, parallel running, and dedicated PM included.
upgrade_path.from_realpage: Enterprise migration from RealPage with full data preservation. Yardi's migration team handles GL mapping, lease abstraction, and historical data transfer.
upgrade_path.from_professional: The most common Yardi upgrade path. All Professional configurations and customizations carry forward. Enhanced with Voyager's enterprise features.
upgrade_path.from_genesis: Full modernization from Genesis to cloud-native Voyager 8. Historical data preserved. Training program included to bridge feature gap.
